system.description: Scrawling mystic characters on a page and sending it out through the mail or by e-mail causes all bureaucratic records of a chantry — utility bills, phone records, property filings — to become lost in the system for the next year. Anyone investigating the chantry through such records suffers a one-Trait penalty for each success you scored in the casting, though this doesn't disrupt the chantry's actual utilities.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
